name: Economic system
description: Who owns and directs the economy.

laws.name: Command economy
laws.description: Central planning; most enterprises are state owned.

laws.name: State capitalism
laws.description: Markets operate, but the state owns strategic sectors and directs investment.

laws.name: Mixed economy
laws.description: A private sector alongside significant public ownership and planning.

laws.name: Social market economy
laws.description: Competitive markets with strong social insurance and labour protections.

laws.name: Free market
laws.description: Private ownership, light regulation and a limited state role.

laws.name: Laissez-faire
laws.description: Minimal regulation, minimal state ownership and low taxation.
